name: Modularize gosleep-timer main.rs
description: Refactor the 4,753-line src/main.rs into cohesive Rust modules while preserving CLI, configuration, timer, Discord IPC, and TUI behavior. Keep the change incremental, avoid new dependencies, and retain the existing tests.

userStories.title: Extract configuration and core data models
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want configuration models and their defaults, normalization, validation, and duration parsing in a focused module so that configuration behavior has a clear owner.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a config module for Config, Actions, action configuration types, defaults, config load/save, normalization, validation, and duration parsing; keep history I/O with CLI integration unless a shared type requires a small core model module.
Update callers to use the module without changing YAML shape, defaults, validation errors, duration parsing, or config paths.
Move or keep the relevant existing tests with the extracted code, including defaults, validation, and duration parsing coverage.
Use crate visibility only for items needed across module boundaries; do not add dependencies or create circular module dependencies.
cargo fmt --check passes.
cargo test --locked passes.
cargo clippy --locked -- -D warnings passes.
cargo build --release --locked passes.

userStories.title: Extract action planning and command display
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want action command construction, preview formatting, and terminal-safe display logic in an actions module so that command planning can be understood and tested independently.
acceptanceCriteria: Move ActionCommand, action command builders, preview command generation, and command display/safety helpers into an actions module that uses the config module from US-001.
Preserve command arguments, ordering, enabled-action filtering, danger classification, shell execution strings, and escaped preview output exactly.
Keep or move the existing action planning and terminal-control escaping tests with the code they cover.
Do not execute real system or custom commands during tests.
cargo fmt --check passes.
cargo test --locked passes.
cargo clippy --locked -- -D warnings passes.
cargo build --release --locked passes.

userStories.title: Extract Discord presence and IPC
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want Discord presence payloads, socket discovery, IPC, and worker lifecycle in a dedicated module so this integration stays separate from timer and TUI code.
acceptanceCriteria: Move DiscordConfig and Discord presence/IPC implementation into a discord module with a small crate-visible interface for timer and TUI callers.
Preserve socket candidate ordering, IPC framing and handshake, presence payloads, update/clear behavior, and worker shutdown semantics.
Keep or move the existing Discord payload, framing, candidate, and lifecycle tests with the module.
Do not add a Discord SDK or other dependency.
cargo fmt --check passes.
cargo test --locked passes.
cargo clippy --locked -- -D warnings passes.
cargo build --release --locked passes.

userStories.title: Extract timer execution and reports
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want countdown execution, action launching, timer reporting, and history entry conversion in a timer module so runtime behavior has a cohesive boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Move timer options, reports, run modes, countdown execution, child command handling, and report-to-history conversion into a timer module using the config and actions modules.
Keep history file presentation and CLI dispatch in the CLI layer; place shared history data types in the narrowest suitable module.
Preserve pause, resume, stop, cancellation, action-result reporting, child output handling, wake confirmation inputs, and timer status behavior.
Keep or move existing timer/runtime tests; tests must use controlled commands and must not invoke destructive system actions.
cargo fmt --check passes.
cargo test --locked passes.
cargo clippy --locked -- -D warnings passes.
cargo build --release --locked passes.

userStories.title: Extract TUI fields and pure view helpers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want TUI field definitions, visibility rules, formatting, and layout helpers in focused TUI support modules so settings and rendering rules are easier to find.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a tui module structure and move field metadata, field visibility, edit-view formatting, duration/countdown formatting, and pure layout or text-wrapping helpers into cohesive submodules.
Preserve field order, groups, hints, edit validation behavior, Unicode handling, compact layouts, wrapping, and terminal-control escaping.
Keep or move the existing pure helper and field behavior tests beside the modules they cover.
Keep Ratatui TestBackend coverage for relevant layout behavior; do not introduce terminal-size assumptions.
cargo fmt --check passes.
cargo test --locked passes.
cargo clippy --locked -- -D warnings passes.
cargo build --release --locked passes.

userStories.title: Move TUI app and rendering into the TUI module
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want TUI application state, input handling, drawing, and event-loop orchestration in the TUI module so terminal UI behavior is independent of CLI wiring.
acceptanceCriteria: Move App and its state, run_tui, event handling, timer-worker coordination, and rendering methods into the tui module, using the helpers from US-005 and the config, actions, timer, and discord interfaces.
Keep module dependencies one-way and limit cross-module visibility to the items required by callers.
Preserve keyboard controls, editing and cancel behavior, save behavior, timer controls, preview content, narrow and wide layouts, and worker result delivery.
Keep or move all existing TUI rendering and interaction tests; retain TestBackend checks for both compact and wide layouts.
cargo fmt --check passes.
cargo test --locked passes.
cargo clippy --locked -- -D warnings passes.
cargo build --release --locked passes.

userStories.title: Extract CLI handlers and slim the binary entry point
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want command dispatch and config, status, history, and stats handlers in a CLI module so main.rs becomes a small application entry point.
acceptanceCriteria: Move CLI command handling, config and history path operations, status/history/stats output, and wake-confirmation prompting into a cohesive CLI module; keep clap argument definitions and main dispatch minimal and clear.
Wire all modules through main.rs without changing command names, flags, output contracts, exit behavior, or config/history file formats.
Remove obsolete imports and dead code; src/main.rs should contain only binary setup, module declarations, and concise command dispatch rather than feature implementations.
Preserve existing tests and run isolated smoke checks with a temporary config for init, validate, status, and preview; do not run against the user's real config or start an action-enabled timer.
